name: Worldpay Account Transfers API
description:
Transfer funds from source account to target account. Authentication header Authorization: {yourcredentials} Replace {yourcredentials} with your base64-encoded Basic Auth username and password given to you by your Worldpay Implementation Manager.

You must use the Authorization header for any request you send to our Account Transfers API.

WP-Api-Version header WP-Api-Version: 2025-0
